sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapter 2 (Trikuta, the lake, the crocodile, the long fight), chapter 3 (the prayer, the lotus, why the gods did not come, Vishnu on Garuda), chapter 4 (the chakra, Huhu's curse by Devala, Indradyumna's curse by Agastya). The exact length of the fight ('a thousand years') should be re-checked against the verses before posting; the script says 'in this telling'.

en.title: The Elephant Who Stopped Pulling | Gajendra
en.description:
What do you do when your own strength is not enough?

Gajendra fought a crocodile for years. He only won when he stopped pulling and called out.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 2-4.
